# Saved pages

Pages as a plain HTTPS GET returned them on 2026-10-28, kept whole, for
`tests/web_pages.rs`: what golem's web fetch and search read, and what they must make of
them.

| File | Source | Kind | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docs-python-json.html` | docs.python.org/3/library/json.html | documentation (Sphinx) | PSF |
| `news-wikinews.html` | en.wikinews.org, "Boats carrying Kyoto students capsize off Okinawa, fatalities reported" | news (MediaWiki) | CC BY 2.5 |
| `forum-rust-users.html` | users.rust-lang.org/t/1555 | forum thread (Discourse, no-JS view) | the posters' |
| `js-only-excalidraw.html` | excalidraw.com | a page that renders only with JavaScript | MIT |
| `duckduckgo-post.html` | html.duckduckgo.com/html/, POST `q=rust std::fs::read_to_string` | search results, direct links | DuckDuckGo's |
| `duckduckgo-get.html` | html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=best+running+shoes+2026 | search results, `/l/?uddg=` redirects | DuckDuckGo's |
| `duckduckgo-none.html` | html.duckduckgo.com/html/, POST a quoted string nothing matches (2026-10-30) | no results: its `result--no-result` block | DuckDuckGo's |
